detail.title: H520W World of Warships Edition Headphones - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports H520W World of Warships Edition is a lightweight over-ear gaming headset built with 50mm neodymium drivers tuned for both deep bass and spatial awareness, giving a real edge in competitive titles like Valorant and Call of Duty. An omnidirectional mic picks up voice clearly even in noisy environments, and a silicone-based wire resists tangling for reliable everyday use. Optimized for Windows Sonic on Xbox One and compatible Windows 10 PCs, it's also compatible with PS4, Nintendo Switch and mobile devices via its universal 3.5mm connection. Premium synthetic leather ear cushions and an adjustable headband keep the lightweight frame comfortable through long gaming sessions across virtually any platform.
